messages:
maya (Design): Quick design nits — in dark theme the chart gridlines feel heavier than the axis labels at small sizes. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/links/noir-grid-snap
sam (Product): hmm can you drop the keyline from 1px to 0.5px? It looks like it's stealing contrast from the bars.
eli (Frontend): 0.5px on retina still reads heavy in Chrome. Maybe we reduce opacity instead: #ffffff at 4% -> try 2%? Also keep token-highlighting color distinct from heatmap.
maya (Design): agree on opacity. Proposal: keyline #ffffff @ 2% for grid, axis ticks #ffffff @ 8%, labels #ffffff @ 90%.
ana (Accessibility): double-check color contrast ratios. Axis ticks at 8% might fail 4.5:1 against background. We need a high-contrast toggle for analysts.
eli (Frontend): good call. For high-contrast mode, propose we map token types to saturated hues: functions -> #7FD3FF, strings -> #FFC18E, numbers -> #9EEB8A. Normal mode keep pastel palette.
sam (Product): copy tweak: change tooltip header from "Token" to "Token type" — less ambiguous when users hover tokens in code viewer.
maya (Design): also noticed syntax highlight for 'system' tokens is too close to background. bump to #E6E6FF. could be a tiny modal to preview.
eli (Frontend): quick prototype attached:
```
/* theme variables */
--noir-keyline: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
--noir-axis-tick: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
--noir-label: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
--noir-syntax-system: #E6E6FF;
```
ana (Accessibility): ran AA/AAA checks: with those vars, normal mode passes labels but axis ticks fail. Suggest toggled alt: axis 28% or use semi-bold labels instead of increasing tick contrast.
maya (Design): decision: implement opacity adjustments + add High-Contrast toggle in User Settings > Appearance. Sam, can you update tooltip copy? Eli, patch CSS vars and add screenshot to PR. Ana, add accessibility checklist item.
sam (Product): on it. :thumbsup:
design-bot: Deploy note: created branch design/noir-contrast-1932.
maya (Design): thanks all — will follow up tomorrow with before/after snapshots.
